Title: Full update with a token cookie returns the new data
Preconditions: A booking created by the test (unique last name)
Test Steps: 1. Create a token. 2. Send PUT /booking/:id with the token cookie and new data.
Test Data: Token cookie; firstname James, totalprice 999, depositpaid false, Dinner
Expected Result: Status 200 and the body equals the new data.

Title: The update is stored (GET returns the new data)
Preconditions: A booking created by the test (unique last name)
Test Steps: 1. Update the booking with a token. 2. Send GET /booking/:id.

Title: Full update with Basic auth works as an alternative to the token
Preconditions: A booking created by the test (unique last name)
Test Steps: 1. Send PUT /booking/:id with the header Authorization: Basic (admin).
Expected Result: Status 200 and the body equals the new data.

Title: Update without any authorization returns 403
Preconditions: A booking created by the test (unique last name)
Test Steps: 1. Send PUT /booking/:id without a token and without Basic auth.

Title: Update with an invalid token returns 403
Preconditions: A booking created by the test (unique last name)
Test Steps: 1. Send PUT /booking/:id with a wrong token cookie.

Title: A rejected update leaves the booking unchanged
Preconditions: A booking created by the test (unique last name)
Test Steps: 1. Send a PUT without authorization. 2. Send GET /booking/:id.
Expected Result: The booking still has its original data.

Title: Update of a booking id that does not exist returns 405
